verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense's own marketing says every transaction is 'controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant.' Its API docs cover S&E budgets, users and cards, and the pricing page lists 'custom approval policies.' The documented approval-policy rules, however, concern AP bills rather than expenses, and nothing describes expense-policy rules or auto-approval with exception routing. missing for 10: documented expense-policy rules by category, role and context; auto-approval of in-policy expenses; exception-only routing to human approvers; any independent or hands-on corroboration.
